name: bug
description: Something isn't working

name: feature
description: A new capability that the product does not have yet

name: enhancement
description: An improvement to something that already exists

name: tech-debt
description: Dead code, cleanup or a refactor with no change in behaviour

name: security
description: A vulnerability, a data leak or a hardening measure

name: accessibility
description: Keyboard, screen reader or WCAG problem

name: performance
description: Speed or cost of the app, the type check, the tests or CI

name: reliability
description: Races, retries, timeouts and data that can end up wrong

name: copy
description: User-facing text that is wrong or unclear

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to documentation

name: tracking
description: Tracking issue that groups sub-issues

name: investigation
description: Measure or research before deciding on a change

name: blocker
description: Blocks other issues: do this first

name: severity:high
description: A security problem, wrong data or a blocked core flow

name: severity:medium
description: A visible bug, or an accessibility blocker with a workaround

name: severity:low
description: Cosmetic, copy, dead code or a latent edge case

name: devops
description: Developer tooling and infrastructure

name: ci
description: GitHub Actions CI: checks, caching and runners

name: cd
description: Deployments: Vercel, preview environments and releases

name: monorepo
description: Nx workspace, packages and package boundaries

name: background-jobs
description: Crons, durable workflows, job queues and scheduled posts

name: testing
description: Tests or test infrastructure (see the test: labels)

name: test:unit
description: Vitest server and model tests (the server projects)

name: test:component
description: Vitest component and hook tests in jsdom (the frontend projects)

name: test:snapshot
description: Vitest snapshot tests (the snapshot projects)

name: test:visual
description: Screenshot tests in Chromium (test:visual)

name: test:e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end tests against a deployment (apps/web-e2e)

name: test:property
description: Property-based tests with fast-check

name: test:integration
description: Tests against real services, such as a real Postgres database

name: test:contract
description: Checks of our integrations against the third-party API contracts

name: test:mutation
description: Mutation testing (Stryker)

name: test:fuzz
description: Fuzz tests of parsers and handlers

name: test:fault-injection
description: Tests that inject failures: timeouts, outages and crashes

name: test:flaky
description: A test that passes and fails on the same code
